text: THE BEST NAIL ART!!! Angela is amazing ❤️
Great first time experience, would go again.
美甲做的超级无敌好！非常细致的法式极致！而且服务也巨好！！！
The girls are all so talented and welcoming. Sarah did my nail design and it came out immaculate. She exceeded my expectations and was so lovely. New LA fav for sure.

KISS LA Nail Boutique is hands-down the BEST nail salon I’ve ever been to.  They can recreate any design you bring in—and somehow make it look even better than the inspiration photo. I’m always blown away by the detail, precision, and creativity. On top of that, my sets literally last up to 6 weeks without lifting or issues, which is unheard of.  The staff is incredibly warm, welcoming, and attentive. You can tell they truly care about their clients and their work. From the moment you walk in, the experience feels elevated, relaxing, and professional.  It’s honestly everything I could ever ask for and more. If you’re looking for flawless nails, long-lasting quality, and amazing service, this is the place. I won’t go anywhere else 💅🏽✨

I got an incredible cateye gel manicure here from Sarah and a pedicure from Angela. They were so detail oriented and took really good care of my hands and feet. They use Russian manicure methods so waterless and they really cleaned up my cuticles really well and safely. The location is really convenient too with metered parking and right by community goods. Highly recommend this place!

This was a cute place with very friendly mom and daughter. I was interested in a place closer to home and was happy to find them. I went in for a full classic set and she was done in less than an hour, that's not normal. It wasn't anywhere near how full I would get at other places who take their time, and after maybe one week I was looking crazy because there was almost nothing left. Fall out was normal, she just didn't take the time to put enough lashes on. I also specifically said I wanted classic, and she seemed disappointed, and then I noticed full fans falling out so she ignored what I said and did what she wanted and I really don't appreciate that. They seem like nice people, it's just not good enough to keep going back. I have tried a lot of different places both independent and chains and this was the worst result out of all of them unfortunately. I wish them continued success but I won't be back.

Jen is amazing and a hoot! You’ll laugh the whole time and leave feeling beautiful and confident. I was on the fence about lash extensions, but now I’m hooked. I look forward to each appointment. If you do your part in keeping the lashes clean and dry, they’ll last weeks!

I’ve recently moved here and I needed a lash girl who could do it like my girl at home, and I found exactly that and more! The environment was amazing so welcoming, the owner and her daughter treat you like they have known you forever! My lashes turned out AMAZING, I am beyond happy with how they turned out!
Jen and Aliyah always do a great job.  I have been going to the for 4 years, they are awesome.   Great customer service!

Poor quality lashes, the owner was completely rude and unwilling to work anything out not even 24hrs after installing a set that didn’t agree with my eyes or my man or my lifestyle! Terrible experience.

Super professional and extremely clean and friendly environment. Jen made sure I was relaxed as it was my first time getting my lashes done so I was extremely nervous but she walked me through the whole process and was super friendly! She did amazing work in making sure I got exactly what I wanted! I’m excited to go back in a couple weeks!
They do an amazing job here and are always so friendly! I highly recommend Aaliyah or Jen. They can do any kind of lash that you would like! My lashes were absolutely beautiful after I left 🥰!

Horrible customer service worst lash set I ever got falling out the same day they were put on. But they blame it on lashes just falling out. No lashes fall out that quickly especially not at other places I don’t recommend. Extremely expensive just to fall out same day.

I was sent to Butterfly Lash Lounge after an awful experience at another salon. The salon is so cute and you couldn’t be more comfortable.Jen and Aaliyah are nothing short of amazing people. They will go above and beyond to the point that I am sure will exceed all of your expectations. I am so thankful that I have found a place where I can get great lashes that last. Give them a try, you won’t so t to go anywhere else!🥰  Jen even does make up, this is a picture on my make up on my wedding day(before my hair was done!)

Cute shop. Friendly. Timely. I'm giving 4 stars because they didn't do lash extensions how I am used to. I think you should ask prior to them being applied to manage your expectations. She was done in 45 min.  I thought it was a 2 hour appt and that is what I'm used to. My lashes weren't washed prior to application which I wasn't used to. In the past, I've had extensions added that were 1-3 lashes per natural lash. They use 10 per natural lash. This is heavy and can cause breakage of your natural lash. The glue is heavy and clumpy. For the price I paid I was expecting a service comparable to experiences at other lash lounges. Again, not a knock on them. They just do things differently so I'd make sure you ask about their technique.

Very sweet, very easy to talk to and very adaptive! Does amazing work and is super understanding!! As someone with social anxiety being around her made me feel very comfortable I will continue to go to her and suggest her to whoever I can!!!!

I’ve been going to Jen at butterfly lash lounge for a couple months now, and i love it! She always makes you feel comfortable and laid back, and she does an amazing job on my lashes every time. ☺️ Always get compliments on them, definitely recommended!
Really good price. Lovely owner :)
I love Jen, she’s awesome at her job but always an Awesome person and great conversationalist!

Jenn is absolutely amazing! Moving 13 hours away from home and terrified to try anyone new, she has made me feel at home while looking FABULOUS! My lashes feel like feathers. Ladies you’re missing out by going anywhere but to her!!!
Love it here! The place is super cute and always clean. Jen does great with mega volume!
Jennifer does fabulous work! She takes pride in her work and her salon is absolutely beautiful!
1st time getting lashes and absolutely loved them. Jen did a great job, professional and explained everything from what she was doing to after care  of the lashes. I will definitely be back.
Such a great experience!!  Absolutely love the way my lashes look when I leave!!!

Jennifer was so sweet and accommodating. She helped me look amazing for my headshots for work. Everything from the length and volume came out flawless.  I've never received so many compliments after getting eyelash extensions. Highly recommended.
I love going! It’s so cute and cozy. And Jen always gets me right 🥰

Rebecca is amazing! She did my bridal makeup— as well as makeup for my two sisters, mom, and MIL— for my wedding, and everyone looked fantastic! She's truly an expert and her warm, friendly demeanor made everyone feel comfortable.  Francelli also rocks at hair and did different styles for everyone, which they all loved. Was so grateful to have the Kiss & Make-Up team a part of my special day!
Rebecca has done my eyebrow twice now and did an exceptionally good job both times. It’s so nice not to have to bother coloring them in.
Francelli did an amazing job shaping and tinting my brows. I felt so good after, highly recommend!

Brow & makeup gurus! One of my very favorite shops for so many reasons-beauty, skincare, makeup, services, gifts, jewelry, all of it!  Not only are my brown fabulous-thanks to many years of being a brow client-but their in house makeup line is top notch. They carry wonderful skin care brands, beautiful jewelry (at a great price point), one of my favorite spots to shop for gifts as well.  Definitely a must visit!
Richard is experienced, talented, and personable. I was very pleased with the microblading he did for me. I highly recommend him.

Richard was amazing at shaping my brows! He was friendly and accommodating and I left so impressed. Already looking forward to my next appointment. If you haven’t been to this salon/cute shop before definitely stop by!
Richard is awesome at shaping brows and does them by hand - no wax or threading. He also did my bridal makeup trial, and he absolutely nailed it!

Small salon but friendly people. I got lash extensions and a make up lesson. Both were great! I learned some things in the lesson and purchased some of the make up that was used. Loved my lashes!! Hard to go back to natural lashes.
